cases.issue: NSEL ne do CBI cases ki joint trial ki demand ki thi payment crisis se judi hui; High Court ne inkaar kiya tha.
cases.held: SC ne joint trial ki demand wale SLP ko dismiss kar diya, bolte hue ki High Court ke faisle mein intervene karne ki zarurat nahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap pe multiple criminal cases chal rahe ho to joint trial ka demand hamesha allow nahi hota, especially jab pehle hi High Court mana kar chuka hai.

cases.issue: CIT(A) ne ex parte order pass kar diya bina assessee ke interest ko sune.
cases.held: ITAT ne ex parte order ko set aside kar diya aur appeal ko fresh hearing ke liye wapas bhej diya, taaki facts ko properly dekha ja sake.
cases.takeaway: Agar CIT(A) ne bina aapki baat sune order diya hai, to aapko ITAT me uspe relief mil sakta hai. Hamesha hearing ka mauka lene ki koshish karo.

cases.issue: Examiner ne Section 68 lagakar genuine trade payables ko credits maan liya tha.
cases.held: ITAT ne genuine trade payables par Section 68 ko lagu nahi maana aur addition delete kar di, jabki GST refund wale issue ko further verification ke liye bheja.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke trade payables genuine hain to sirf credits hone par Section 68 nahi lagta. Trading entries ko detail mein document karo.

cases.issue: GST registration ko retrospective tareeq se bina notice diye cancel kar diya gaya tha.
cases.held: High Court ne retrospective cancellation cancel kar di jab SCN mein clear nahi tha ki retrospective cancellation propose ho rahi hai. Court ne fresh SCN bhejne ki permission di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka GST registration bina notice ke pichle tareeq se cancel ho raha hai to aapko relief mil sakta hai. Notice mein saaf mention hona chahiye retrospective action ka.

cases.issue: Property investment ki additions kiye gaye jab CIT(A) ne additional evidence consider kiya bina AO ka remand report liye.
cases.held: ITAT ne additions restore kar diye kyunki CIT(A) ko pehle AO ka remand report lena tha additional evidence dekh ke.
cases.takeaway: Agar appellate authority additional evidence dekhti hai to AO ka remand report mandatory hai. Ensure karo ki aapke case mein procedure follow ho.

cases.issue: Related party charter hire expenses ke addition lagaye gaye the section 153A me bina incriminating evidence ke.
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diye kyunki koi incriminating material nahi tha; charter hire charges bhi comparable rate se kam the, isliye business expense allow hua.
cases.takeaway: Section 153A ke cases me agar incriminating material nahi hai to additions tik nahi sakte. Related party expense extensively document karo.

cases.issue: Skill development trust ne Section 12AB registration ki demand ki thi trust ko charitable proof karte hue.
cases.held: ITAT ne trust ko charitable maana aur Section 12AB registration grant karne ka nirdesh diya.
cases.takeaway: Skill development ya training ventures ke charitable trust ko 12AB registration mil sakta hai jab charitable character clear ho.
